## Summary

**Bug:** In `packages/data-plane/src/avails.ts`, the `blockBreakId` variable (which tracks the DATERANGE id seen in the current segment's tag block) was only cleared at a media URI line. In back-to-back ad break scenarios — where one break ends at the exact instant the next one begins with no regular programming between them — the CUE-IN of the first break could be immediately followed by the CUE-OUT of the second break without any intervening URI line. This caused `blockBreakId` to retain the first break's DATERANGE id, leading to the second break inheriting the first break's producer break id.

**Fix:** Added `blockBreakId = undefined;` to the CUE-IN handler, so the id is cleared when an avail closes, in addition to the existing clearing at the URI line. This is a minimal, targeted fix that doesn't affect any existing marker syntax handling.

**Files modified:**
- `packages/data-plane/src/avails.ts` — added the clear in the CUE-IN branch.
- `packages/data-plane/dist/avails.js` — recompiled via `npm run build`.
